text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Huh, the Goddess statue? Why did I 
even come here?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'm pretty beat, huh... Maybe I'll 
take a quick breather here.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I've never really 
taken a good, close look at the Goddess 
Statue, but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's such a photogenic selfie 
pose! The usual Goddesses sure know how to 
bring their A-game!
